posts.author: Ikaro
posts.body: Hi, I was trying to make a common event were when running the actor's character changes momentarily to enhance the dynamic of the project, however the script doesn't work, but doesn't give an error message either.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
From the
MV / MZ Script Call List
(Set Actor Map Character, row ~477):
actor
.setCharacterImage(
filename
,
index
);
$gamePlayer.refresh();
Click to expand...
So your script call should be:
JavaScript:
$gameActors.actor(1).setCharacterImage('&actor1', 0);
$gamePlayer.refresh();
A couple of other notes:
MZ makes HTML games, so all filenames should conform to network standards.
&
is a reserved character for URLs, so the filename
&actor1.png
may cause unexpected results in-game.
Don't write integers with zeroes in front. I.e. use
1
, not
0001
. Why? Because in JavaScript, leading zeroes indicate an octal value. E.g.
0010
is another way of writing the decimal number
8
, and
0009
is just invalid. (Also,
1
is quicker to write than
0001
.)
